integrity: The infinite proof is elementary once the published divisor-sum identities are fixed: it separates odd composites, twice-odd composites, and multiples of four. The bundled computation reconstructs the published coefficient normalization independently from divisor sums and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The constants refer to Kang's fixed normalization of the coefficient sequence. The result does not optimize over all prime-detecting elements or prove perturbation stability. Finite replay through 20,000 is corroborative only.
title: Sharp composite separation for the parity-twisted crank prime detector
